title: The Texas Tech center fielder screwed up big time to start U-M's second inning,
snippet: The Texas Tech center fielder screwed up big time to start U-M's second inning, whiffing a single into a triple. Now, there are runners on the corners, nobody out, and the Wolverines are in business.
